children: A subsidiary of Tootsie Roll Industries acquired the Mexican confectionary business of The Klass Co., including the Winis brand of chewy candies.

The acquisition by Tootsie Roll subsidiary Tutsi, S.A. de C.V., was completed on Tuesday, the company said in a regulatory filing. It said the deal would complement its existing candy business in Mexico, which features the Tutsi Pop brand.
